concerns.text: Task T001 bundles many distinct deliverables (environment check script, config module, requirements pinning, checksum generation, timing context manager, quickstart documentation) into a single task. This granularity is too coarse for deterministic execution; downstream atomization may be needed to ensure each deliverable can be built, tested, and verified independently.

Task T010 combines report generation, multiple figure creations, and markdown assembly into one task. The scope spans several independent artifacts, making it overly coarse. Splitting into separate tasks (e.g., one for figure generation, one for markdown synthesis) would improve executability and verification.
